conditions.name: Rapid Hair Whitening
conditions.details: Rapid greying over short period, started a few months after bladder symptoms. Likely linked to overstimulated sympathetic nervous system.

conditions.name: Possible Subclinical Hypothyroidism

conditions.name: Nighttime Dry Mouth
conditions.details: Particularly after sexual activity and during sleep. Related to overstimulated SNS and late bedtime.

action_plans.title: Bladder Retraining - Urge Suppression
steps: When hearing running water: STOP, stand still
Deep belly breaths to calm SNS
5-6 fast pelvic floor squeezes (Kegels)
Distract mind (count backwards, read something)
Wait 30-60 seconds for urge to pass
Walk slowly to toilet - never run
Gradually extend hold time to 5, 10, 15 minutes

TELL GP: Ask about blood clotting factors if concerned

conversation_insights.insight: Bladder leaks NOT caused by oil/fat deficiency - diet provides excellent fats from whole foods
Running-water trigger is nerve-reflex based (conditioned bladder reflex), not mechanical
Hair whitening + bladder symptoms together suggest overstimulated Sympathetic Nervous System
TSH 5.1 jumped from 2.3/2.9 baseline - significant individual trend even if within lab 'normal'
Biotin from daily seeds/nuts/eggs may falsely LOWER TSH readings on lab equipment
Hair whitening may be REVERSIBLE if caused by B12 deficiency or thyroid dysfunction
Vitamin D deficiency is likely (hard to get from food alone) - drives pelvic floor weakness and hair greying
Zinc absorption may be impaired due to phytic acid in raw seeds - soaking overnight helps

Ginkgo biloba: POTENTIAL BENEFIT for hair pigmentation (improves micro-capillary blood flow to follicles) and dry mouth (supports salivary glands). RISK: can stimulate bladder muscle (detrusor) worsening urgency. CRITICAL: DO NOT combine with Salvia - both are potent blood thinners, excessive bleeding risk. HOLD until GP consultation and blood test results.
Fluid timing: stop ALL liquids 2hrs before bed. After sex, take small rolling sips (not gulps) to avoid overfilling bladder.
Ginkgo does NOT contain biotin - safe to take during 48-hr pre-test seed break. But fast completely morning of test.
Excess honey and sultanas can alter urine acidity and irritate bladder wall - keep minimal.
